links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated clinic letters (Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: ChatGPT letters were lengthy and complex at university reading level; traditional letters were easiest to read (12-15-year-old level).
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved the highest accuracy (average 92.6%) and satisfaction ratings (4.59/5) but produced lengthy, complex letters with readability at a university level.

links.outcome: Accuracy and omission of details in AI scribe-generated clinic letters
links.effect: Heidi accuracy 85% with occasional omission of nuanced details; ChatGPT 92.6% accuracy; traditional method 58.81%.
links.quote: Heidi demonstrated consistent accuracy (85%) and structured outputs, with an average satisfaction rating of 4.34/5, although it occasionally omitted nuanced details.

screen.reason: Compares LLM/ambient AI documentation tools against traditional dictation methods on scripted simulated dermatology consultations.
